# Find EWS special folders by server flags, not display names

Exchange special-folder names can differ from IMAP names and can be localized by the organization. During account creation, do not classify EWS notable folders by name; use the EWS flags and folder identity path instead.

Scope: exchange.

Paths:

- `mail/components/accountcreation/modules/CreateInBackend.sys.mjs`
